Ranchi: Nisha Bhagat kes men thanedar par giri gaj! pithoriya thanedar shatish pande ko kiya gaya lain hajir
Nisha bhagat kes men bari prashasnik karravaee huee hai. mamle men laparvahi aur uth rahe savalon ke bich pithoriya thana prabhari shatish pande par gaj giri hai.unhen lain hajir kar diya gaya hai. nisha bhagat ki maut ke mamle men lagatar virodh aur nishpaksh janch ki mang uth rahi thi.
